case.summary: This case was triggered by a customer report regarding transaction 3491361 for $39.08. The graph and case evidence showed a recurring charge pattern of 6 earlier transactions of $39.08 with the same product code W, billing region 126, and email every ~10 days since 2016-08-21, alongside 13 earlier card-present purchases in billing region 126. The initial fraud probability was 0.42 and the final fraud probability was 0.02. The verdict is legitimate, and the case was closed as legitimate (status closed_legitimate) because the cardholder confirmed the transaction as their own (assumed reply; assumption recorded in evidence_requests).
